title: S&P 500 futures fall after August jobs data
title_zh: 8 月就业数据公布后标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌
summary: Sept 4 (Reuters) - Futures tracking the benchmark S&P 500 index turned negative on Friday after data showed the U.S. economy added more-than-expected jobs in August.
summary_zh: 路透 9 月 4 日 - 数据显示美国 8 月份就业增长超预期后，追踪基准标准普尔 500 指数的期货周五转为负值。

title: Are Meta and Nvidia redefining value vs. growth stocks in the era of AI?
title_zh: Meta 和 Nvidia 是否正在重新定义人工智能时代的价值股与成长股？
summary: WisdomTree Global chief investment officer Jeremy Schwartz joins Market Catalyst's host Julie Hyman to explain why Meta (META) and Nvidia (NVDA) are leading the Magnificent Seven as growth stocks.
summary_zh: WisdomTree Global 首席投资官杰里米·施瓦茨 (Jeremy Schwartz) 与 Market Catalyst 的主持人朱莉·海曼 (Julie Hyman) 一起解释了为什么 Meta (META) 和 Nvidia (NVDA) 作为成长股在七巨头...

title: Traders brace for US jobs data after Fed's Waller soothes bond markets
title_zh: 美联储沃勒安抚债券市场后，交易员等待美国就业数据
summary: By Marc Jones LONDON, Sept 4 (Reuters) - World shares tip-toed higher ahead of U.S. jobs data on Friday, while bond markets got some much-needed relief after a top Federal Reserve official cooled rate
summary_zh: 路透伦敦9月4日 - 在周五美国就业数据公布之前，世界股市小幅走高，而在美联储高级官员降息后，债券市场得到了一些急需的缓解

title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 futures rise ahead of key jobs report
title_zh: 纳斯达克、标准普尔 500 指数期货在重要就业报告发布前上涨
summary: By Niket Nishant and Tharuniyaa Lakshmi Sept 4 (Reuters) - Futures tracking the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 and the benchmark S&P 500 indexes rose on Friday ahead of jobs data that could test the recent
summary_zh: 作者：Niket Nishant 和 Tharuniyaa Lakshmi 9 月 4 日（路透社）——追踪以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数和基准标准普尔 500 指数的期货周五上涨，此前就业数据可能会测试近期的就业数据。

title: Apple's first foldable iPhone may cost $2,000
title_zh: 苹果首款可折叠 iPhone 售价可能高达 2000 美元
summary: Get ready to pay up for Apple!

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures diverge after blowout jobs report
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在井喷式就业报告后出现分歧
summary: All eyes were on the August jobs report for clues about the health of the labor market and whether the data could tip Fed interest rate bets one way or the other.
summary_zh: 所有的目光都集中在八月份的就业报告上，寻找有关劳动力市场健康状况的线索，以及该数据是否会以某种方式影响美联储的利率押注。

title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is 'playing both sides' of AI with Hugging Face purchase
title_zh: Nvidia 的 Jensen Huang 通过购买 Hugging Face 来“玩弄人工智能的两面性”
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is buying AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion in a move that could extend Nvidia's reach in the AI ecosystem beyond being just a chip supplier.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 将以 129 亿美元收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face，此举可能会扩大英伟达在人工智能生态系统中的影响力，而不仅仅是一家芯片供应商。

title: Broadcom's 2028 AI revenue outlook is what's really 'important'
title_zh: 博通 2028 年人工智能收入前景才是真正“重要”的
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) reported quarterly earnings on Wednesday that only modestly beat Wall Street's expectations.
summary_zh: 博通（AVGO）周三公布的季度收益仅略高于华尔街的预期。

title: How Nvidia's latest deal continues to target all points of the AI trade
title_zh: 英伟达的最新交易如何继续瞄准人工智能行业的所有领域
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to report on Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, the company's bet on open AI models, and now accounting for 8% of the S&P 500 market cap.
